scope: QueuePanel HTML draggable eligibility only; no handler, order, self-drop, focus, editor or queue mutation changes.

entry_reachability.targets_1_to_6: All reached the draggable assertion and failed true!==false. None contains a drag-start call, so no target handler-entry assertion was skipped after the first failure; there is no such assertion in those case bodies.
entry_reachability.enabled_controls: Cases 9/10/11/13 invoked only enabled multirow drag-start. Case 9 proved payload and own drag state; 10 distinct-target reorder; 11 self-drop; 13 drag-end cleanup.
entry_reachability.green_scope: Identical GREEN can prove all six render draggable=false and preserve enabled entry controls. It does not invoke a disabled singleton callback or prove physical/native gesture suppression. No handler guard is added or claimed tested.
